Title: Register with valid details
Preconditions: App reachable, email not previously registered
Steps: 1. Go to /auth/register. 2. Fill First name, Last name, DOB, Country, Postcode, House number, Phone, Email (unique), Password meeting policy. 3. Click Register.
ExpectedResult: Account is created and a success indicator/redirect to login is shown; no error messages displayed.
Notes: Verified live 2026-08-03: registration succeeded and redirected to /auth/login.

Title: Register with policy-violating password
Preconditions: On /auth/register with all other fields valid
Steps: 1. Fill all fields with a password missing multiple policy rules (e.g. no uppercase/number/special char). 2. Click Register.
ExpectedResult: Registration is blocked; no account is created.
Notes: Verified live 2026-08-03 with password 'weakpass': submit did not redirect, stayed on /auth/register.

Title: Register with duplicate email
Preconditions: An account already exists for the test email
Steps: 1. Fill registration form using an already-registered email and otherwise valid data. 2. Click Register.
ExpectedResult: Registration is blocked; no duplicate account is created.
Notes: Verified live 2026-08-03: re-registering an already-used email stayed on /auth/register (blocked).

Title: Login with valid credentials and verify profile
Steps: 1. Go to /auth/login. 2. Enter valid email/password. 3. Click Login. 4. Open account/profile page.
ExpectedResult: Login succeeds; profile page shows the first name, last name and address entered at registration.
Notes: Verified live 2026-08-03: profile page fields matched registration data exactly.

Title: Login with invalid credentials
Steps: 1. Go to /auth/login. 2. Enter a non-existent email with a wrong password. 3. Click Login.
ExpectedResult: A generic authentication error is shown; user remains logged out; no session/token is created.
Notes: Verified live 2026-08-03: exact message shown was 'Invalid email or password'; stayed on /auth/login.

Title: Add product to cart and update quantity
Preconditions: Cart has at least one line item
Steps: 1. Add a product to the cart. 2. Open cart. 3. Change the line item quantity. 4. Observe line price and cart total.
ExpectedResult: Line price and cart total recalculate correctly for the new quantity.
Notes: Verified live 2026-08-03: qty 2->5 on a $14.15 item updated both line price and cart total to $70.75 (5 x 14.15).

Title: Checkout via Cash on Delivery requires Confirm twice for invoice
Preconditions: Logged in, cart has at least one item, checkout form completed with Cash on Delivery
Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout, select Cash on Delivery, fill billing details. 2. Click Confirm once. 3. Observe state - invoice should NOT yet be generated. 4. Click Confirm a second time.
ExpectedResult: After the first click, 'Payment was successful' shows but no invoice yet (known app behavior). After the second click, 'Thanks for your order! Your invoice number is INV-...' is shown.
Notes: Verified live 2026-08-03 for both a guest checkout (INV-2026000005) and a logged-in checkout (INV-2026000006): identical two-click behavior both times.

Title: View generated invoice under My Invoices
Preconditions: An order has just been completed via TC-M-07 as a logged-in user
Steps: 1. Navigate to My Invoices. 2. Open the most recent invoice.
ExpectedResult: The invoice from the order just placed appears in the list with correct products, quantities, totals and billing address.
Notes: DEFECT FOUND 2026-08-03: after a logged-in checkout confirmed 'Your invoice number is INV-2026000006', My Invoices showed 0 rows, and GET /invoices with that user's own bearer token independently confirmed total:0. See ai-prompts/automation-and-debugging.md Entry 3 for full root-cause investigation (likely short-lived, 5-minute JWT expiring mid-checkout). Direct API calls (register->login->cart->invoice) do persist and list correctly, isolating this to the UI checkout flow specifically.
